archetype: Architectural High-Density Dark Terminal (Archetype 7 meets Archetype 4)
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a high-density, performance-driven dark crypto sportsbook UI. Use React, Tailwind CSS v4, Lucide icons, Framer Motion, and custom sleek elements. The main layout consists of a top persistent nav header, left sports/league navigation drawer/sidebar, central high-density odds & live scores feed, and a sticky or collapsible right-side dynamic bet slip / active bets drawer. Ensure instant odds update feedback, clear bet slip calculations (Singles/Parlay), real-time simulated crypto wallet management (BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL), simulated transaction histories, and live score updates. All interactive elements MUST have explicit data-testid attributes. Ensure full support for .js / .jsx code files.

typography.heading_font: Cabinet Grotesk / Outfit / Unbounded style (sans-serif display, high intensity, tracking-tight)
typography.body_font: Inter / System Sans with JetBrains Mono for all numeric odds, balances, multipliers, and timestamps

layout_and_grid.app_structure: 3-Column Terminal Layout: Left Sidebar (Sports Categories & Leagues, 240px wide), Center Feed (Main Odds Grid, Live Matches, Hero Highlights, flex-1), Right Drawer (Dynamic Bet Slip, Multiplier Calculator, Wallet Quick Deposit, 320px wide)
layout_and_grid.spacing_philosophy: High Density layout with clean 1px borders (border-zinc-800) and optical padding (p-3 to p-6). Avoid cramped collision by keeping 12px min padding on interactive cells.
layout_and_grid.odds_buttons_grid: 3-Column layout for 1X2 (Home / Draw / Away) or 2-Column for Spread/Totals with monospaced odds, interactive click to add to slip.

surface_strategies.card_style: Cardless grid or flat crisp dark surfaces (#12141C) with subtle 1px border (#2A2F45), hover elevation with micro light outline transition.
surface_strategies.header_style: Crystal Glass backdrop-blur-md bg-[#090A0F]/90 border-b border-[#2A2F45] fixed top-0 z-50
surface_strategies.bet_slip_style: Fixed right drawer or overlay panel with sticky summary footer for instant placing of bets.

key_functionalities_to_implement: Live Sports & Odds Browser (Football, Basketball, Soccer, Tennis, Esports) powered by free ESPN APIs / mock fallback with real-time simulated odds flux
Dynamic Interactive Bet Slip (Single bets, Parlay multipliers, stake input with instant payout calculation, clear all, quick bet buttons like +$10, +$50, Max)
Crypto Wallet Hub (Simulated BTC, ETH, SOL, USDT balances, Deposit QR Modal, Withdraw form, mock payment gateway pluggable interface)
Bet History & Open Bets Ledger (Live status, Won, Lost, Cashout option, simulated live score tracking)
JWT Authentication Modal / Drawer (Email + Password Login & Register, user profile, wallet balance state)
Live Scoreboard Widget (Real-time score updates, match minute counter, possession indicators)
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic AI slop: Do not use light centered cards or pure black #000000 without subtle dark surface tinting.

Data Test IDs: ALL buttons, input fields, tabs, navigation links, sports items, odds buttons, slip items, deposit inputs, and modal triggers MUST contain explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='odds-button-home-1', data-testid='bet-slip-stake-input', data-testid='wallet-deposit-button').
Odds Button Animations: Flash subtle green when odds increase, flash subtle red when odds decrease.
Monospace tabular numbers: Always use font-mono for numbers, odds, prices, timer counters, and transaction hashes.
Toast Feedback: Use Sonner toast notifications when a selection is added/removed from bet slip, when a bet is placed, or wallet funds deposited.
File Extensions: Write pure JavaScript (.js / .jsx) components without TypeScript syntax errors.
